executive_summary: This lecture examines deep learning fundamentals and neural network optimization. The curriculum focuses on gradient descent optimization algorithms and learning rate schedules for generalization on unseen test data. Batch normalization normalizes intermediate layer activations across each mini-batch to zero mean and unit variance, followed by learnable scale and shift parameters. Standard gradient descent without momentum can stall near flat plateaus because the gradient magnitude approaches zero in all directions simultaneously.
